quest.title: The Moonlit Watcher
quest.description: The Lightkeepers stationed at Cliffwatch Camp seem to have run into some trouble...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x4

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Where could they be? Ugh, this is turning into a major headache...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: What now, Boss? Forget our brothers and sisters over at the lighthouse, waiting to get to work... If we don't have enough fuel, it's lights out for the entire camp.

dialogues.speaker: Egle
dialogues.text: Yeah. We gotta think of something, Squad Leader.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Mm... Don't worry.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Head back to your posts. I'll take care of this.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, good to see you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, Illuga. Why's everyone gathered here at the entrance?

choices.text: Seems like you've got a lot on your plate.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Eh, it's fine. Just a minor issue, really, and I'm already on the case.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw, c'mon Illuga! You're always trying to fix things by yourself on the down low. Just tell us, it couldn't hurt!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Or is it 'cause you're too embarrassed to say?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Haha, no way. I just don't want everyone in town worrying about things that I can handle on my own.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: But since you're both part of the investigation squad now, I won't treat you like outsiders.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Still, this isn't exactly the place for a chat. Come on in, I'll tell you more inside.

choices.text: Has something happened?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, Paimon's been wanting to ask for a while now... What are these vehicle thingies we keep seeing in the Lightkeepers' camps? They kinda look like food trucks, don'cha think?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It'd be awesome if you really could cook up there, but Paimon has a feeling there's more to these things than meets the eye...

choices.text: Maybe it's a chef bot capable only of the finest haute cuisine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... What? Yeah, that wasn't what Paimon was getting at...

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Oh, these? Officially, they're called "Moonwagons." They're transportation tools we made by modifying Snezhnayan mechanical vehicles.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: You can think of them as kuuvahki-powered mobile lighthouses.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: They're not quick by any means, but they save us a whole lot of trouble and manpower when it comes to transporting supplies.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: As for cooking functionality, I hadn't actually given that any thought. But you know, if we did install a toaster in there...

choices.text: Relax, you don't have to take Paimon that seriously.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: No, no. Filling stomachs is a key part of a Ratnik's duties too. Thanks for reminding me of that, Paimon.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: A proper food truck would save us from having to build makeshift stone stoves just to eat a hot meal.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right? And that way, you could even hold your own bonfire parties, too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, except everyone does seem really busy. Not sure they'd be in the mood for that...

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Actually, I really hope that one day we can. Just the thought of it makes me smile.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: But that day will have to wait — for now, at least.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... It's all 'cause of the Wild Hunt, isn't it?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: It is indeed. As you've seen for yourselves, it's continued to grow in strength. Vigilance is our only option.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Not only must we shore up our bases themselves, we also need to ensure that the roads are clear — which entails dispatching Ratniki at regular intervals to patrol vast areas of land...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Just listening to all that is kinda tiring already. You Lightkeepers sure have it tough.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: And that's just the basics.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: The real danger lies with those Wild Hunt outbreaks that suddenly just appear out of nowhere. Such tasks are all handled by Gramps, Flins, Olav, and those guys.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: I can't have Gramps fretting over every last thing, so I've taken over handling of the groundwork.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Honestly, compared to our shortage of manpower, supply prep is nothing. To continue on the topic of food, even the best cook in the world couldn't do anything without ingredients.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Over the years, many of our former bases have fallen into disrepair, making them ill-suited for long-term postings.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: At the moment, everyone has to shuttle back and forth between our camps and HQ, leading to fewer and fewer people available for combat deployments.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Got a solution in mind?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Yep, and that's turning this place into a permanent base. And most importantly, what's a Lightkeeper stronghold without a lighthouse?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you wanna build one here?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Exactly. We'll need it if we're to stand any chance against the Wild Hunt's attacks...

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Which is easy to say, but in practice... I think you've seen enough to know it's not going too smoothly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right... Paimon almost forgot that we were here to help. So, what's the issue?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Well, building our encampment will require lots of fuel and supplies. Generally, we bring it all in on Moonwagons all the way from Piramida.

choices.text: Couldn't you get materials from somewhere nearer?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Ah, if only it were so simple. The main problem is, we need a special kind of oil refined using kuuvahki.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: It's true that the plants nearby are full of kuuvahki, and they'll keep us going — for a while, at least... But supplying the fuel for a lighthouse is a whole other ball game.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Unfortunately, though, there's been no sign of the supplies that should have arrived last night.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Valdis is in charge of transport, and he's always been meticulous, so it's unlikely that he got careless and missed the timing or something.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: And that's precisely why I'm worried that they might have encountered some trouble...

choices.text: Hold up, deep breaths...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah. There's always a way outta every jam — even if that means being trapped inside a sealed barrel, or getting buried neck-deep!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Surely this can't be any worse than that?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Hah, don't tell me that's actually happened? I guess I underestimated you two again...

choices.text: If you think that's wild...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, we can have a look around. Maybe they've just lost their way?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Mm... Maybe so. Anyway, there's no time to lose, so follow me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup. Let's move!

choices.text: We've been to prison in the Fortress of Meropide as well...
Don't get too worked up. I've seen things like this happen many times before.
I see lots of potential timber nearby.
That food truck bit was a joke.
Maybe it can transform into a battle bot.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: For real? You mean the type that'd grab a spoon and start attacking you if you said you didn't like its cooking?

talks.objective: Check on the person crying for help

dialogues.speaker: Valdis
dialogues.text: S—Squad Leader! Thank the gods, you're here! Please, help me!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Valdis... How did you end up here?

dialogues.speaker: Valdis
dialogues.text: It's... a long story. But the barrier created by these Mandragoras can't be broken from inside, so I've been stuck in here for almost the whole day!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Hmm, something about this doesn't quite add up. This place isn't on the main road from Piramida, nor is it some sort of shortcut.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: And as for the Mandragoras, they wouldn't usually bother passers-by unless they were trespassing on their territory.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: In short, I'd like an explanation as to how you ended up here — and a reasonable one, at that, or you might have to stay in there a while longer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, you don't usually see Illuga getting angry... Paimon's kinda scared now, too.

choices.text: A Squad Leader's gotta have a more imposing side, after all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true... Guess being an adventurer really does have its advantages. It's a good thing we're only honorary squad members, or we'd be subject to his discipline, too.

response.speaker: Valdis
response.text: Agh... Alright, alright. Last night, I found the path to our camp blocked by a large group of Mandragoras.

response.speaker: Valdis
response.text: You know how I like studying insects and plants, Squad Leader... and it was such a rare sight to see this many Mandragoras gathered in one place.

response.speaker: Valdis
response.text: I didn't wanna miss the opportunity, so I followed them all the way here. But then...

response.speaker: Valdis
response.text: Ahh, I'm so sorry! I'll take responsibility for this, I promise. How about... I cover night watch for the coming week? No, make that the whole month!

choices.text: Let's just rescue him first...

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: You're right. We can discuss the breaking of regulations after we get back. For now, let's concentrate on getting him out of here.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: #I could use your help again, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Valdis
response.text: *sob* Thank you...

choices.text: Y'know, we already have the supplies, so...

response.speaker: Valdis
response.text: Wh—What do you mean? You're not just gonna leave me here, are you? Please! I know I was in the wrong!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y'know, he does look really sorry... Let's just save him first, alright? He's got enough punishment waiting for him as it is...

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: You're right, Paimon. We can discuss the breaking of regulations after we get back. For now, let's concentrate on getting him out of here.

choices.text: Besides, the Lightkeepers are known for their discipline.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Alrighty. That's the issue resolved, and our fuel stocks replenished. Thank you both very much.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, don't mention it! We're part of the team, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Speaking of the team, how's Valdis doing?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Hmm. He neglected his duty while escorting a supply shipment, which is a violation of our regulations.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: However, he did encounter a pretty dangerous situation related to the Wild Hunt, and we didn't end up suffering any losses.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: As such, as per his wishes, he'll be responsible for protecting the lighthouse throughout its next month of construction.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, hope he doesn't start slacking off again. Now that she's a member of the team, Paimon's gonna start coming down to check up on him — oh, and to see how the lighthouse is coming along, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of which... Paimon wonders what it'll look like once it's all done.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: It won't be as impressive as the one at Final Night Cemetery, that's for sure. Still, it'll be bright enough to serve as a beacon to guide travelers through the night.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: So long as we're able to keep people safe, whether from the Wild Hunt or anything else, our efforts will not have been in vain.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Anyway, I should go back to sorting through our archives. All that work isn't gonna do itself...

choices.text: No rest for a Ratnik, huh...

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Don't worry, we won't be this busy forever. We should be able to put our feet up a bit once this place is up and running.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In that case, we'll help you out! That way, it'll be done in no time!

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Your help would be most welcome, believe me! But... I'm sure you've got a lot on your plate already. And asking you to come all this way just to do our work for us... it wouldn't feel right.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Hmm... How about this, then? If you find anything useful during your adventures and you happen to be passing by, feel free to drop it off.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, it's no biggie! Like you said, we're squadmates now, hehe!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Isn't that right, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Haha... In that case, let me say again that it's an honor to have you as my squadmates.

choices.text: Just don't overwork yourself, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew. Finally drove off those monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's going on here? Surely they couldn't have been waiting in ambush this whole time...?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: The Wild Hunt... The Mandragoras... Ah, I get it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Have you figured something out, Illuga?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Valdis, I think these Mandragoras trapped you inside the barrier to protect you.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: They're very sensitive to shifts in their environment. I myself heard some strange murmurs on the way here.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, it must've come from the Wild Hunt monsters, who had yet to manifest at that time.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: These Mandragoras must have detected them very early on, which is why they barred your path and prevented you from continuing onward...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Only to have you follow them anyway, leaving them no choice but to trap you here for your protection.

dialogues.speaker: Valdis
dialogues.text: I see, so that's what was going on... No wonder they refused to leave the area...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: They probably only protected you because they detected the scent of grass and flowers on your person... perhaps because of all the time you spend around them.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Either way, thank you both. There doesn't seem to be any further danger.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, there they go. Adorable little fellas, huh? And they didn't even ask for a reward!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Imagine if we had them around to watch our backs — we'd never have to worry about being ambushed while opening treasure chests again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, putting it like that, it was kinda understandable that Valdis would wanna follow them...

dialogues.speaker: Valdis
dialogues.text: Right? Finally, someone understands me!

choices.text: Nice try, buddy...

response.speaker: Valdis
response.text: ...I know, I know, I'm sorry... I'll take whatever's coming to me...

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Alright. Now that we've got him out, let's head back. The others are probably starting to worry.

choices.text: But that's no excuse for neglecting your duties.
